name: edgar_foreign_issuers
description:
Foreign private issuer filings (20-F annual report, 6-K current report, 40-F Canadian annual report) for one company, from SEC EDGAR (data.sec.gov submissions).
Returns {cik, company_name, form_type, form_description, filings_count, filings: [{accessionNumber, filingDate, reportDate, form, primaryDocument, primaryDocDescription, document_url}]}, newest first; document_url is an SEC viewer link.
Inputs (* required): cik* (string, SEC Central Index Key, up to 10 digits; from edgar_company_search), form_type* (20-F | 6-K | 40-F; schema default 20-F), limit (integer 1-100, default 20).
Only the recent-filings block of the EDGAR submissions file is searched. US domestic filers use 10-K/10-Q/8-K instead (edgar_filings_by_form).
Example: {"cik": "0001046179", "form_type": "20-F", "limit": 5}
No API key needed (SEC data.sec.gov; 110 ms between requests).

cik.description: Central Index Key (CIK), up to 10 digits

form_type.description: Foreign issuer form: 20-F annual report, 6-K current report, 40-F Canadian annual report
